Updated for the Dungeon Settlers game update DS_B.0.4.29 (Steam build 25846389). Older Hotbar versions turn themselves off on this build.
Key names on the Hotbar follow the keyboard layout chosen in the game options (QWERTY, QWERTZ, AZERTY or JIS).
Tested together with Dungeon Settlers Delvers: Core 0.4.1 and Frieren 0.4.1. If you use Delvers, update both to 0.4.1.
The DLLs no longer contain a local build path.
Author and license notes now name Fre-yin only.
The discontinued Extended Hotbar Helper was removed.
